content:
olivia-finance: Heads up — NovaHealth (private) disputed their March invoice claiming platform fee should be reduced because they ran a planned migration for 3.25h and were told by the migration runbook that fees would be exempt. Attached their runbook and a screenshot of the slack convo.
diego-sales: talked to their AM — there was no Redwood approval recorded. They did send the runbook to infra@redwood but didn't get a confirmation.
samira-cs: checking telemetry — migration tag present on pool nova-prod-mig from 2026-03-15T02:00Z to 2026-03-15T05:15Z. Reserved commit still active. They also performed a post-migration scale test that used on-demand nodes for ~0.75h.
olivia-finance: invoice INV-2026-342 snapshot:
```
INV-2026-342
reserved_commit_hours: 744 => $37,200
platform_fee: dedicated => $9,360
support_enterprise => $3,120
```
Customer asks to waive $9,360.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-342 generated 2026-03-17T14:11Z. Metering shows reserved_commit_hours=744. No Redwood approval record for maintenance exemption.
diego-sales: customer is upset; they argue the runbook and slack confirm our ops saw it but didn't respond.
harper-legal: contract check — SOW says exemptions require written prior approval. However, we can do a one-time concession to preserve the account if it's commercially justified.
evan-cfo: propose a standard concession formula: pro-rated platform fee for verified maintenance window + flat goodwill cap of $2,500 for private deployments. Approve if within cap.
olivia-finance: compute: $9,360 / 744h = $12.58/hr. For 3.25h => pro-rated $40.9. With goodwill cap => offer $2,500 credit. But let's keep variable: either pro-rated + 10% uplift or flat $2,500.
samira-cs: telemetry shows extra on-demand usage 0.75h so not eligible.
diego-sales: recommend we offer $2,000 credit plus commit to a migration notification workflow improvement. Customer likely accepts.
harper-legal: approve $2,000 if we get explicit written acceptance and add standard clause for future.
olivia-finance: will create CM-2026-332 for $2,000 pending signature. Ticket #billing-ops-9077. Mark invoice status "under_settlement".
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-332 created. Ledger adjustment pending signed acceptance.
diego-sales: I'll send settlement and workflow update.
olivia-finance: note for ops: create alert to auto-suggest pro-rate when migration tag present next billing cycle.
billing-bot: Alert rule suggestion created: rule_id=alert-mig-2026-12.
olivia-finance: closing loop — NovaHealth accepted $2k credit and agreed to sign the migration addendum. :white_check_mark:
